messages:
anya: Heads-up — during a routine audit I noticed some older cold snapshots in the glacier tier might be encrypted with an old CMK that we rotated last month.

sec-bot: Alert: snapshot s3://redwood-backups/prod/2024-11-02.tar.gz flagged (SSE-S3 -> no-CMK). Detected by backup-verifier v1.3

sam: wait, do we have automatic re-encrypt on restore enabled? I thought we set bucket default to SSE-KMS.

kevin: We have bucket default SSE-KMS, but some legacy lifecycle transitions created copies under the glacier vault without kms headers. Policy oversight during migration.

anya: Ok. impact: backups are at rest encrypted (SSE-S3) but not under our customer CMK. That means we can't audit key usage in CloudTrail for those objects and we can't revoke a tenant-level key for those old blobs.

trent: high-level plan: 1) identify all objects not using CMK 2) re-encrypt in place with CMK or restore->encrypt->replace 3) patch lifecycle/migration job to set `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header -> SSE-KMS 4) add alert to backup-verifier

sam: For RBAC: we need a temporary bind so SRE backup role can perform re-encrypt. Propose a 48h scoped permission via `iam:PassRole` and `kms:Encrypt,kms:ReEncrypt*` limited to resource arn:aws:kms:::key/REDACTED

kevin: add audit logging step: CloudTrail Data Events for S3 + KMS GenerateDataKey/Encrypt logs. Also add an entry in our internal audit index (elk) with tag `backup-reencrypt`.

anya: vuln triage: is this exploitable? Not directly, but it's an escalation-of-trust risk if teams assumed CMK enforcement. Recommend classification P2 and notify compliance.

sec-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-142 created by anya: "legacy-coldstore-not-cmk". Assigned: sam, kevin. Due: 24h.

sam: I'll run a dry-run script to list candidates:
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-backups --query "Contents[?StorageClass==`GLACIER`]"
# then aws s3api head-object each and check ServerSideEncryption header
```

kevin: I'll prepare a temporary IAM policy. Questions: do we re-encrypt in place (S3 copy-object with SSE-KMS) or restore -> encrypt -> archive? Copy is faster but may double storage costs during process.

trent: prioritize recent 3 months first. Older than 1 year we can metadata-only archive and schedule phased re-encrypt.

anya: also need KMS key policy review — make sure `kms:ReEncryptFrom` allowed for the backup principal. I'll ping legal/compliance after we confirm scope.

sam: Action items: sam -> dry run + list (ETA 4h), kevin -> temp IAM + kms policy (ETA 6h), trent -> lifecycle job patch + test (ETA 24h), anya -> open compliance notif + incident doc (ETA 2h). I'll update INC ticket.

kevin: FYI adding logging snippet to our runbook:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ReEncrypt
```

anya: thanks everyone. i'll tie into runbook and schedule a restore test once re-encrypt is done. :thumbsup:
